card.name: Weekday letter codes in course schedules
card.fires_on: Single-letter weekday abbreviations (M, T, W, Th, F) inside compressed class-day strings such as MTWThF, in university course listings and office hours. Also weaker on MTW or MTH as abbreviations.

modes.label: Class-day strings
modes.description: A letter inside a run of weekday codes before a class time.
modes.example: ATM S 101: Weather (5) NW SLN 10593 MTW<<Th>> 10:30-1

modes.label: Office-hours days
modes.description: Weekday letters like MWF after hours of availability.
